## Powerpoint Visuals 

<br>

### Key Finding 1: Overall referrals are going down, but they vary a lot from county to county 
####	Slide 7: Overall, referrals to the juvenile justice system in the 12 Quest counties declined 18 percent since 2015.

```{r echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
theme_set(theme_minimal(20, base_family = "Calibri"))

## use gather for line plot
df_referrals_overall_plot <- df_cases_analysis_referral_overall %>%
  gather(`Year`, Count, `2015`:`2020`) %>% 
  filter(Year!="2020",
         `Statute Severity` %in% c('Felony','Misdemeanor','Status','Total')) %>% ### only looking at data through 2019
  mutate(`% Change 2015 to 2019` = ifelse(Year!="2019", NA, `% Change 2015 to 2019`))  

###geom_line 
overall_referrals_1 <- 
  ggplot(data = df_referrals_overall_plot, aes(x = `Year`, y = Count, color = `Statute Severity`, group = `Statute Severity`)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", size = 2) +
  geom_line(size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 3) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "# of Referrals", color="Statue Severity", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(label=scales::comma, limits=c(min(df_referrals_overall_plot$Count-1000), 
                                           max(df_referrals_overall_plot$Count+1000))) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
                panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef")) +
  # guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) + 
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = scales::percent(as.numeric(`% Change 2015 to 2019`)), fill = c("#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef",
                                                                                              "#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef",
                                                                                              "#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef",
                                                                                              "#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef",
                                                                                              "#00475d","#007392","#0db4e4","#9ed4ef")),
                   nudge_x = 1,
                   label.padding = 0.3,
                   box.padding = 0.15,
                   color = "white",
                   segment.color = NA,
                   fontface = "bold",
                   na.rm = TRUE,
                   show.legend = FALSE)

  
ggsave("C:\\Users\\abyrum\\The Council of State Governments\\JC Research - JJ_Indiana - JJ_Indiana\\Data\\Output\\Visuals\\overall_referrals_1.png", overall_referrals_1, width = 8, height = 6) 
```
